denied.title: Restricted access
denied.hint: Checkout is reserved for salon accounts. Ask your administrator for access.

day.timeZoneHint: Times are shown in the salon’s time zone.

notInDay.title: Appointment not found on this day
notInDay.body: The requested appointment is not on the schedule for {date}. Change day, or pick one from the list below.

list.caption: Appointments of the day
list.emptyBody: Nothing to settle on {date}. Change day to find a service that was delivered.

recap.caption: Service to settle
recap.fixedPrice: Amount fixed at booking time. The total that counts is the one the server recalculates on validation — the front end never does that arithmetic.

method.cashHint: Recorded with the operator and a timestamp; the till is the reference at reconciliation.
method.cardHint: The amount is keyed on the salon’s own bank terminal, which is not wired to the application. No card number is entered, seen or kept.

blocker.cancelled: This appointment is cancelled: the slot has been released, there is no service left to settle.
blocker.alreadySettled: This appointment has already been settled: a second payment would create one accounting record too many.
blocker.onlinePaymentOpen: An online payment is still in flight on this appointment. Wait for it to conclude — a counter settlement would be refused while it runs.
blocker.onlinePaymentFailed: A failed online payment intent is still attached to this appointment. It must be cleared before settling at the counter.

settlement.title: Settled {method} — {amount}
settlement.nothingLeft: There is nothing left to settle on this appointment.

ticket.priceDrift: The receipt total ({ticket}) differs from the amount fixed at booking ({booked}). The receipt is what counts at checkout: announce that amount.
ticket.settlementsCaption: Settlements already recorded on this receipt
ticket.replayed: Replayed submission: this settlement was already recorded. Nothing was taken twice.

amount.partialHint: Clear it to settle everything left to pay in one go.
amount.invalid: Unreadable amount. Enter a sum such as “28.00”.
amount.tooHigh: That amount is more than what is left to pay ({amount}).
amount.tenderedLabel: Amount handed over by the client
amount.tenderedHint: Optional. The change to give back is computed by the server.
amount.tenderedTooLow: The amount handed over must cover the settlement ({amount}).

terminal.instructionTitle: Key this amount on the terminal
terminal.instructionBody: The terminal is the salon’s own, from its bank: the application does not talk to it. Run the card, then declare the outcome below.
terminal.referenceHint: Optional — the operation number the terminal prints. At most 32 alphanumeric characters, no spaces or dashes.
terminal.referenceInvalid: At most 32 alphanumeric characters, no spaces or dashes.
terminal.declinedNotice: Payment declined on the terminal. Nothing was recorded: pick another method, or try again.

pci.cash: No call to the payment provider on this path: the sale is recorded with its operator and its timestamp, and the till is the reference at reconciliation.
pci.card: The salon’s terminal stands alone: the application does not talk to it and receives no card data. No number is entered here, nor written down anywhere else.

receipt.heading: Till receipt
receipt.loadFailed: The receipt could not be loaded. Check the connection and try again.
receipt.label: Receipt
receipt.cashDisclaimer: Settlement recorded and timestamped, with its operator. The till and the terminal’s printout are the reference at reconciliation.

completion.settled: Moving the appointment to “completed” stays a salon gesture: the settlement is recorded, the status is changed from the schedule.

failure.providerUnreachable: The till did not answer. Nothing was taken: try again in a moment.
failure.alreadySettled: This receipt has already been settled in full. Reload the screen before carrying on — a second payment would create one accounting record too many.
failure.notPayable: This appointment no longer accepts a settlement: it is cancelled. Nothing was taken.
failure.notSettleable: This appointment is cancelled: there is no service left to settle.
failure.overpayment: That amount is more than what is left to pay on the receipt. Nothing was taken: reload the screen to read the remainder again.
failure.terminalReferenceRefused: The terminal receipt number was refused: at most 32 alphanumeric characters, and it cannot look like a card number.
failure.tooManyRequests: Too many requests in a short time. Wait a few seconds before trying again.
failure.notFound: This appointment cannot be found in this salon.
failure.forbidden: Your account is not allowed to take payments. Ask the salon administrator for access.

sale.itemUnavailable: An item on the receipt is no longer on sale. Remove it and reload the catalog before carrying on.
sale.currencyMismatch: An item on the receipt is priced in a currency other than the salon’s. It cannot be sold here: remove it from the receipt.
sale.amountOutOfRange: The total exceeds what a single receipt can carry. Reduce the quantities, or split it into several receipts.
sale.historyWindowInvalid: The requested period is empty: the end must come after the start.
sale.validation: The receipt was refused: a line is incomplete or out of bounds. Check the quantities before trying again.
sale.notFound: A service or an item on the receipt cannot be found in this salon.
sale.forbidden: Your account is not allowed to run the till. Ask the salon administrator for access.
sale.unavailable: The till is temporarily unreachable. The receipt was not recorded: try again in a moment.

pdf.failed: The receipt could not be produced. Please try again.
